personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 4 Tactile soft rounded components and earthy agricultural tones
personality_one_liner: A clean, grounded, and trustworthy agricultural command center that feels approachable and professional for farmers.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Avoid dense clusters; use safe spacing around cards (lg) and inner card padding (lg).

do's: Sticky 'Get Fertilizer Plan' CTA bottom container

screens.name: Auth

states.loading: Spinner in center of solid brand gradient

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Huge 'RythuMitra' display text and sub-branding. Mobile Number and Password text inputs placed in the lower third inside a glassmorphic or semi-transparent container, followed by a wide pill-shaped primary CTA.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main dashboard for IoT monitoring and farm overview.

states.empty: Illustration of farm with 'Connect your first device' CTA
states.error: Error banner at top: 'Unable to sync sensors', Retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Greeting (Good Morning + Name), Avatar, Bell icon. Sticky filter: Field selector dropdown (glass/tinted). Scrollable content: Alert banner (warning surface), IoT Device Card (status, battery %, Play/Pause/Stop/Sync controls), 2x2 grid for Live Sensor Data (N, P, K, Soil Moisture - using flexWrap: wrap, width: 48%, space-between) featuring big numeric values and status pills.

screens.name: Advice
screens.purpose: AI-powered fertilizer and crop recommendation generator.

states.empty: Select a field to get recommendations

screens.layout: Top section: 'Configure Query' card (dropdowns for Type, AI Model, Field). Large sticky 'Get Fertilizer Plan' CTA pinned to the bottom of the screen. Middle section (after generation): Soil Health Status (row of 3 tiles), warning banner, AI recommendation cards in a vertical stack.

screens.name: Planner

states.empty: No active crops, start a new cultivation cycle

screens.layout: Header: Crop name, Field, Duration, Day X of Y. Overall progress bar underneath. 'Today's Task' highlighted hero card (Mark Done CTA + Voice Guide). 'Daily Reminders' toggle. Below: Vertical timeline stepper (left-bordered line with absolute dots/icons) listing Completed, Today, and Upcoming tasks.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User configuration, language settings, and farm details.
screens.layout: Top: Deep forest-green primary gradient header (brandSecondary -> brandPrimary) overlapping a white card containing Avatar, Name, Phone. Horizontal scroll row of 3 stat pills (Fields, Acres, Score). Vertical list of editable cards: Personal Details, Farm Details, Device Info, Settings (Language toggle), and a subtle Logout button at the bottom.

splash_background.alt: Close up of wheat field, used for splash/auth background

farm_empty_state.alt: Rows of green crops at sunset for empty/loading states

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Vibe: Ensure the UI feels like a clean iOS-Native dashboard but uses earthy forest greens. Use `expo-linear-gradient` for the signature deep green headers (#0F5D2A -> #1E8A3E) in the Profile and Auth screens.
Data Display: Sensor cards (N, P, K, Moisture) must use clear, large typography for values and status pills ('Good', 'Low'). Use a 2-column flex-wrap grid with `justifyContent: 'space-between'`.
Mic FAB: Render the Whisper voice query floating action button above the bottom tab bar. Give it a distinct `brandTertiary` background or glassmorphic blur so it stands out but feels integrated.
Sticky Actions: The 'Get Fertilizer Plan' CTA must be sticky at the bottom of the screen (above the tab bar/safe area).
Image Overlay Contrast: Apply a vertical gradient scrim overlay over the splash background image to ensure the white login form and logo are highly readable.
Activity Stepper: Build the Planner timeline with a left-positioned vertical line and absolute-positioned circular icons marking the status of each task.
Implement the specified `haptics` on all corresponding interactions using expo-haptics.
